subject: Inferno Summit - storyboard, one-pager & demo script (edits)
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha@infernoevents.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Inferno Summit - storyboard, one-pager & demo script (edits)

Samantha / Inferno team —

Thanks again for confirming Redwood as a Premier Sponsor at Inferno Summit (May 11-12). The marketing team asked me to send a quick kickoff note on collateral and the demo flow so we can finalize creative this week. High-level asks below: 

1) One-pager: short benefits-oriented single page focused on "Predictable LLM Inference" — need final copy and fonts/brand lock by EOD Friday.
2) Slides: 12-slide sponsor deck + 3-slide demo handoff (we'll use our standard deck template; we attached latest).
3) Live demo script: 6-minute demo, two short failover branches (model fallbacks / low-availability message). We need a tightened script and stage cues by Monday.
4) Storyboard / scene wires: a single-page visual for the demo flow (intro -> prompt -> response -> divergence -> fallback). We're open to a simple figma wireframe.

Laura — looping you for slide/script edits. Ben — can you confirm any specific product messaging we should avoid (e.g., feature names in preview)?

Samantha — can you confirm the production's AV constraints (mic lapel vs. headset, streaming latency tolerance) and whether you need any extra assets for the sponsor table?

Thanks — short turnaround here but manageable if we lock decisions today.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
pri...@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0124

Attachment: Inferno_Slate_1pager_v2.pdf (one-pager draft)
Attachment: Inferno_Slides_v4.pptx (Redwood sponsor deck, working)

From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha@infernoevents.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Inferno Summit - storyboard, one-pager & demo script (edits)

Hi Priyom — great to have Redwood on board. Quick answers: 

- AV: lapel preferred for clean audio; we will provide a streamer box for HDMI + backup SDI. End-to-end stream latency target is under 2s; if you route through cloud we recommend a 300ms tolerance.
- Stage: 10min slot reserved for partners — we'll keep the demo to 6 minutes as requested and have a quick Q&A after.
- Sponsor table: send print-ready one-pager by Friday 5pm PT. We can print on-site if you provide PDF with bleed.

I'll share production's staging wireframe and the backstage runbook (permissions) in a separate Drive link by EOD. 

Samantha Ortiz
Production Director, Inferno Events
SamanthaOrtiz@infernoevents.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Samantha Ortiz <samantha@infernoevents.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 6 Mar 2027 10:37:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Inferno Summit - storyboard, one-pager & demo script (edits)

Thanks — quick pass from marketing on copy and slides. My notes below and I've attached a cleaned demo script (inference-demo_script_v3.docx):

One-pager (attached PDF):
- Header: change to "Predictable inference for production LLMs" (shorter).
- Remove the sentence that promises cost reduction by a specific %; replace with: "controls unit cost through batching, caching, and model routing."
- Add a customer quote placeholder on the lower right (we'll swap with ACME's quote if legal signs off).

Slides:
- Slide 3 (architecture): simplify the diagram — remove internal kernel names; use "Optimized kernels" only.
- Slide 7 (SLA): add a single line about fallback routing to cheaper model variants.

Demo script (attached doc):
- Tightened to 5:45 runtime, cut the second variant scenario to a 20s summary and move the fallback branch earlier.
- Stage cue: "on cue, switch to simulated degraded node (red light)" — we need production to confirm they can trigger this.

Ben — flagged product phrasing: avoid "adaptive quantization" in the public demo; instead use "model compression techniques."

Laura Bennett
Director, Field Marketing, Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.ai
Attachment: inference-demo_script_v3.docx

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Inferno Summit - storyboard, one-pager & demo script (edits)

Quick thumbs up from product. On the phrasing note — agreed with Laura. Also adding: please do NOT show our internal model ID strings on slides; redact or replace with neutral names ("Redwood-Gen-X").

I can join the Thurs run-through if you want a dry-run for the demo triggers.

Ben Carter

1) One-pager: Laura updated PDF attached (Inferno_Slate_1pager_v2.pdf) — Samantha, please confirm print specs (bleed/trim) by EOD Thurs so we can deliver to on-site print.
2) Slides: updated deck attached (Inferno_Slides_v4.pptx). Laura: final copy edits done; Ben: product phrasing redacted.
3) Demo script: attached doc (inference-demo_script_v3.docx) — 5:45 runtime. Laura and Ben, please review the highlighted fallback language and green-light by Friday.
4) Storyboard: quick figma wireframe link below — production, can you confirm you can trigger the "degraded node" cue during the run-through? If yes we will keep the staged fallback.

Run-throughs: proposed times — Thurs 3/11 10:00 PT (video) and Fri 3/12 09:00 PT (dress). Ben, please confirm availability for Thurs.

Samantha — delivery of print assets and AV checklist would be huge. Thanks all for the fast turnaround.

— Priyom
